verdict.rationale: Lock-in and data portability are fair questions for a relay/CDN product, so the axis applies. However, the pack documents no feature for exporting a user's stored data in open formats. Self-hosting, an open protocol, and CMAF/HLS output reduce lock-in but are adjacent features, not a data-export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
